text: Who was the greatest financier in the Bible? Noah — he floated his stock while everyone else was in complete liquidation!
Who was the greatest babysitter in Scripture? David — because he rocked Goliath fast to sleep!
Why didn't Noah go fishing very often on the ark? Because he only had two worms!
At what time of day was Adam created? Just a little before Eve!
Why did the pioneer Sunday School class cross the desert? To get to the Promised Land on time!
Who was the smartest businessman in the Old Testament? Abraham — because he knew a Lot!
What kind of lighting did Noah install on the Ark? Floodlights!
Why couldn't the prophet Jonah trust the ocean? Because he knew there was something fishy about it!
Which biblical character was the best bowler? Peter — because he was always on the roll at Pentecost!
How do we know tennis was played in biblical times? Because Joseph served in Pharaoh's court!
